description: Negative conformance for the collapsed campaign roles: an artifact declaring kind eligibilityProof or conversionProof MUST be rejected because neither is a distinct object type in the thirteen-artifact inventory (README.md#core-objects; 08-governance/glossary.md). Eligibility and conversion are roles a ProofOfMatch plays inside a campaign, not separate schemas or wire kinds (governance/protocol-object-model-decisions-2026-08-08.md, 'Three rule/proof pairs' decision).

rejectCases.reason: Eligibility Proof is a role a ProofOfMatch plays inside a campaign, not a distinct object type (08-governance/glossary.md#eligibility-proof).
Conversion Proof is a role a ProofOfMatch plays inside a campaign, not a distinct object type (08-governance/glossary.md#conversion-proof).
